chunks.en: Communism, when, when you reach the stage of communism, there is no more class struggle. From each according to the community, to each according to the society. Right? Why are you being exploited? Your use value when you produce less than you exchange value. Isn't it?

chunks.en: Tell you what you can and cannot do. This refers to naming the use of AI. Okay? This is important. I think this is very serious. I just talked about the use of computers in fashion. chunks.zh: 告诉你什么可以做，什么不可以做。这指的是命名人工智能的使用。明白吗？这很重要。我认为这非常严重。我刚刚谈到了计算机在时尚中的使用。在时尚中没有很多这样的计算机。在人文学科中。我认为它就在这里，对吧？整个人工智能的事情正在促使人们重新思考我们，学生如何提交答案。所以大多数人已经走向或者正在走向，即使你正在走向那种东西。

One, you cannot take my question, put it into an AI program, whatever the program, and say generate a 1,500-word answer. It will generate the answer in three seconds. I will not read your. You will score 100% on the 30-in AI level. All right? So you can't do that.
chunks.zh: 我不会阅读你的论文，好吗？让我把这件事说清楚。我为什么允许你使用人工智能？但我认为你不应该只是简单地使用人工智能。所以有三种情况你不能使用人工智能。第一，你不能把我的问题输入到人工智能程序里，不管用什么程序，然后说生成一篇1500字的答案。它三秒钟就会生成答案。我不会阅读你的。你将在AI水平的30项测试中得100分，好吗？所以你不能那样做。

chunks.en: And also of the view that this is actually not very good. AI does help, but AI don't write very good essays, in my view. And I will use that as a basis for comparison. Right? Firstly, AI is very good at providing an overview, but not very good at providing depth of analysis,

chunks.en: spin analysis, not deep analysis. Right? And it writes flowery language, but it's big words, but there's no soul to the answer. So it is a complete air answer. That's almost like the same. So everywhere I get some students, less and less every year, who say, oh, I'm using it to check grammar, use Grammarly for example. chunks.zh: 你不能用人工智能来检查你的英语。不，因为你不能用它来检查你的英语，因为我无法区分用于检查英语的人工智能和用于提问的人工智能。这几乎是一样的。所以我遇到的一些学生，每年越来越少，他们会说，哦，我是用它来检查语法的，比如用Grammarly。Grammarly现在不再是一个语法检查器，它是一个完整的人工智能程序。

chunks.en: and generate an answer in three seconds. Right? It's not fair to the rest of your customers. So I will not read those assignments. If it falls into one of these three categories. chunks.en: readings, could be other people's speech, but it could also, and I do think religion is very personal, but you can't be talking some personal evidence. That's not evidence.
